Website Settings.label: Enable Opportunity Portal
Website Settings.description: Enables the public opportunity list, opportunity detail pages, and applicant portal integration.

Website Settings.label: Enable Public Opportunity Listing
Website Settings.description: Allows opportunities with Public visibility to appear to guests.

Website Settings.label: Enable External Applications
Website Settings.description: Allows signed-in website users with an external profile to submit applications.

Website Settings.label: Require External Profile before Application
Website Settings.description: Applications use the authenticated user's External Person profile as the person master record.

Website Settings.label: Show Upcoming Opportunities
Website Settings.description: Shows published opportunities before their Opening Date, without allowing application submission.

Website Settings.label: Show Closed Opportunities
Website Settings.description: Keeps closed opportunity details visible while preventing new applications.

Website Settings.label: Opportunities per Page
Website Settings.description: Maximum number of opportunities loaded per page. Values are limited to 6–50.

Website Settings.label: Standard Website Integration
Website Settings.options: The portal uses the Website Theme selected in Website Settings, the standard website header and footer, Portal Settings navigation, standard login and signup controls, route redirects, and website indexing controls.
